groups.name: raf.ai.providers
groups.description: Named AI provider configurations. Each key is a provider identifier (e.g. openai, claude, deepseek).

properties.name: raf.ai.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable the AI multi-provider integration.

properties.name: raf.ai.default-provider
properties.description: Default AI provider used when no provider is specified in the request. Must match a key in raf.ai.providers.

properties.name: raf.ai.routes
properties.description: Scene-to-provider routing map. Key is a scene name (e.g. 'code', 'summary'), value is a provider key. Takes precedence over default-provider.

properties.name: raf.ai.session.max-history
properties.description: Maximum number of historical messages retained per session. Older messages are evicted using a sliding window.

properties.name: raf.ai.session.ttl
properties.description: Session TTL in seconds. Sessions expire automatically after this duration of inactivity.

properties.name: raf.ai.providers
properties.description: AI provider configurations keyed by provider name (e.g. openai, claude, deepseek).

properties.name: raf.ai.providers[*].api-key
properties.description: API key for this provider. Use Jasypt encryption or environment variable injection for production.

properties.name: raf.ai.providers[*].base-url
properties.description: Base URL for the provider's API endpoint. Useful for proxies or self-hosted models.

properties.name: raf.ai.providers[*].model
properties.description: Model identifier to use, e.g. gpt-4o, claude-opus-4-5, deepseek-chat.

properties.name: raf.ai.providers[*].temperature
properties.description: Sampling temperature (0.0-2.0). Lower values produce more deterministic output; higher values increase creativity.

properties.name: raf.ai.providers[*].max-tokens
properties.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate in the response.

properties.name: raf.ai.providers[*].timeout
properties.description: Request timeout in seconds for this provider.
